alt: California Department of Health Care Services Public Records Act response letter for R007794-070626.
full_text: California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) Reference No.: R007794-070626. Public Records Request received on July 06, 2026. Requesting copies of translated DHCS forms including DHCS 4521, 6195, 6224, 6236, 8250, MC 219, MC 220, and MC 306. DHCS located copies in English, but acknowledged that some forms are not available in all of the non-English threshold languages requested by Nicolas Hernandez.
summary: Official Public Records Act correspondence from DHCS acknowledging gaps in translated Medi-Cal forms across California's threshold languages.
